dockerfile.amd64:
# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1

FROM ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/baseimage-selkies:ubunturesolute

ENV LSIO_FIRST_PARTY=true

# set version label
ARG BUILD_DATE
ARG VERSION
ARG PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE
LABEL build_version="Linuxserver.io version:- ${VERSION} Build-date:- ${BUILD_DATE}"
LABEL maintainer="thelamer"

# title
ENV TITLE="Craft Apps" \
    NO_FULL=true \
    SELKIES_DESKTOP=true \
    PIXELFLUX_WAYLAND=true

RUN \
  echo "**** add icon ****" && \
  curl -o \
    /usr/share/selkies/www/icon.png \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/linuxserver/docker-templates/master/linuxserver.io/img/artcraft-logo.png && \
  echo "**** install packages ****" && \
  add-apt-repository ppa:xtradeb/apps && \
  apt-get update && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    caja \
    chromium \
    chromium-l10n \
    libegl1 \
    xdg-desktop-portal \
    xdg-desktop-portal-gtk && \
  echo "**** install photocraft ****" && \
  if [ -z ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE+x} ]; then \
    PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/photocraft/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name'); \
  fi && \
  curl -o \
    /tmp/photocraft.deb -L \
    "https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/releases/download/${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE}/photocraft-$(echo ${PHOTOCRAFT_RELEASE} | sed 's/^v//g')-linux-x86_64.deb" && \
  echo "**** install craft suite ****" && \
  for APP in designcraft effectcraft figcraft filmcraft lightcraft pdfcraft vectorcraft; do \
    APP_RELEASE=$(curl -sX GET "https://api.github.com/repos/storytold/${APP}/releases/latest" \
      | jq -r '.tag_name') && \
    curl -o \
      /tmp/${APP}.deb -L \
      "https://github.com/storytold/${APP}/releases/download/${APP_RELEASE}/${APP}-$(echo ${APP_RELEASE} | sed 's/^v//g')-linux-x86_64.deb"; \
  done && \
  apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    /tmp/*.deb && \
  echo "**** application tweaks ****" && \
  mv \
    /usr/bin/chromium \
    /usr/bin/chromium-real && \
  sed -i \
    's/^Icon=.*/Icon=system-file-manager-symbolic/' \
    /usr/share/applications/caja.desktop && \
  echo "**** cleanup ****" && \
  apt-get autoclean && \
  rm -rf \
    /config/.cache \
    /tmp/* \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-autorun-software.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-browser.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-computer.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-file-management-properties.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-folder-handler.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/caja-home.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/debian-uxterm.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/debian-xterm.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/footclient.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/foot-server.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-about.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-color-select.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/mate-network-scheme.desktop \
    /usr/share/applications/st.desktop \
    /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    /var/tmp/*

# add local files
COPY /root /

# ports and volumes
EXPOSE 3001

VOLUME /config

notes.upstream:
## What's Changed
* Grant network access so update checks can reach GitHub by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9982
* Correct update_transport comment: Flatpak sandbox now has network by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9983
* Honor CARGO_BUILD_TARGET in FreeBSD packaging for aarch64 release builds by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9989
* Engine: a pixel change damages only the tiles that changed (#9329) by @brennanMKE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9942
* Perf: every frame records its stages; slow frames are kept, logged and reported (#9328) by @brennanMKE in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9943
* Arabic interface language, combined from the community catalogs (#10005) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10006
* ADDED ARABIC TRANSLATION by @azizr12 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/2505
* Add Arabic (ar) as the first right-to-left UI language by @hicbest in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4520
* Add Arabic (العربية) interface translation with RTL alignment by @hasan-sdaif in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/4569
* i18n: Arabic interface with RTL display order by @NibrasAz7 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5593
* Add Arabic (ar) interface translation catalog by @vfggf95565 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/5915
* i18n(ar): stage Arabic catalog and add user guides by @syrrevshin4202-prog in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6092
* i18n(ar): add complete Arabic UI translations by @test-bit-sys in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6287
* Actions: an Arrange step that can't move the layer plays on instead of stopping (#8453) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8457
* Reduce Noise: reuse guide statistics with bit-identical output by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9639
* Median stacking: select the middle values without fully sorting by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9628
* perf(stack): cache bounded entropy terms across pixels by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9622
* perf(algo): row-parallel local_sharpen with fast-path protect_detail (#5426) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9651
* perf(retouch): avoid duplicate rasterization while drawing by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9532
* Save for Web: WebP, lossy at its Quality or lossless (part of #6391, #2415) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6421
* Free Transform moves every selected layer (#6501, #3384, #6096) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6590
* Select and Mask: Photoshop's full-window workspace (#7069, #8148) by @wanikhawar in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8896
* i18n(ar): the Select and Mask workspace strings; main is green again (#10173) by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10174
* Enable update checks in Flatpak by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10206
* Integration test: 24 parity PRs together by @FedeOlivares in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/9166
* CLI: run and batch skip Deselect with nothing selected, as playback does by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8807
* Layers: a new fill or adjustment layer drops the selection it took as mask by @switch87 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8811
* Indexed Color: keep Brush strokes inside the colour table (#8669) by @xwize in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8823
* ui: larger Align icons and overflow button; Save for Web keeps its width on an invalid Matte by @batuhangozegu in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8892
* fix: File > Import > Variable Data Sets opens a file picker (#8816) by @MarekSpodBiedry in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/8901
